This year, renewables are set to become the largest source of global electricity generation for the first time in history. 

But are we doing enough to ensure that this progress reaches the 1.18 billion people living in energy poverty and the 685 million people without access to electricity? Now is the time to act.

On #CleanEnergyDay, sustainable energy stands as a critical lever for climate and development goals. To truly deliver change for everyone, we must: drive transformative action, including reimagining our financial architecture; leverage digital innovation; and fostering cooperation at all levels - local, regional, national and global. 🌎

Learn how we can drive targeted, transformative action to scale our efforts for everyone, everywhere. ▶️ 👇

#EnergyForDevelopment⚡️ #EnergyTransition
